# ghp_secret_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the ghp secrets engine. Each read of `<backend>/creds/<name>` mints a short-lived ghp token scoped by the role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Agent tokens bound to a GitHub App installation, limited to one repository.
resource "ghp_secret_role" "ci" {
  backend         = ghp_secret_backend.ghp.path
  name            = "ci"
  token_type      = "agent"
  installation_id = 12345
  repositories    = ["example/app"]
  scopes          = ["contents:read", "pull_requests:write"]

  ttl     = 3600
  max_ttl = 28800
}

# OAuth-backed proxy tokens.
resource "ghp_secret_role" "proxy" {
  backend    = ghp_secret_backend.ghp.path
  name       = "proxy"
  token_type = "proxy"
  scopes     = ["contents:read"]
  ttl        = 1800
  max_ttl    = 14400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the ghp secrets engine. Changing it forces a new role.
- `name` (String) Name of the role. Changing it forces a new role.

### Optional

- `app_record_id` (String) Optional ghp App record id (UUID) to pin agent tokens to; empty selects ghp's default app.
- `installation_id` (Number) ghp App installation id the minted agent token is bound to (required when token_type is "agent").
- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.
- `repositories` (List of String) Optional repositories the minted token is restricted to; empty is open-scoped (all repositories).
- `scopes` (List of String) Optional ghp permission:level scopes (e.g. ["contents:read", "pull_requests:write"]); empty is open-scoped.
- `session_prefix` (String) Prefix for the ghp session id of each minted token (default "vault").
- `token_type` (String) ghp token type to mint: "agent" (default) or "proxy".
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/roles/<name>.
terraform import ghp_secret_role.ci ghp/roles/ci
```
